# Stock Wide Array(Nullable(String)) fixture

Generated by scripts/generate_array_nullable_string_fixture.sh with the
pinned ClickHouse 26.7.1.1315 official build in a disposable local store. The
captured part contains pk UInt64 and a Array(Nullable(String)), inserted as
RowBinary and checked by stock CHECK TABLE before publication.

The 11 sorted keys are 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13, 17, 19, 21, 25, with six data
marks [2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1]. The marks cover empty outer arrays, mixed
NULL/empty/binary values, an all-NULL array mark, another empty outer mark,
present empty strings, and a short final row with UTF-8 and embedded-NUL
bytes. Stock NULL slots have zero nested String size.

The array has exactly four physical substreams: a.size0, a.null, a.size, and
a. The part uses Wide layout, LZ4 data, and plain .mrk2 marks with a sentinel
record. The verifier decodes all five streams (including pk) and checks exact
raw bytes, flattened NULL slots, per-stream mark offsets, and physical file
inventory independently of checksums.txt. SHA256SUMS pins every captured part
file. Scope is the pinned producer build and this exact schema; it does not
establish compatibility for deeper Nullable or Array compositions.
